@common.sound.mute.context: Sound volume choice: no sound. Shown in the Machine menu, the Settings dialog and the toolbar/status bar alike.

@common.sound.low.context: Sound volume choice. Shown in the Machine menu, the Settings dialog and the toolbar/status bar alike.

@common.sound.medium.context: Sound volume choice. Shown in the Machine menu, the Settings dialog and the toolbar/status bar alike.

@common.sound.high.context: Sound volume choice. Shown in the Machine menu, the Settings dialog and the toolbar/status bar alike.

@common.sound.highest.context: Sound volume choice: full volume. Shown in the Machine menu, the Settings dialog and the toolbar/status bar alike.

@common.speed.normal.context: Emulation speed choice: the real machine's speed (1x). Shown in the Machine menu, the Settings dialog and the toolbar/status bar alike.

@common.speed.multiplier.context: Emulation speed choice: this many times faster than the real machine, e.g. '4x'. Change only if your language writes multipliers differently. Shown in the Machine menu, the Settings dialog and the toolbar/status bar alike.

@common.mouse.sensitivity.verySlow.context: Mouse sensitivity choice (ZX Spectrum Next mouse): how fast the emulated pointer moves; keep the multiplier in brackets. Shown in the Machine menu and the Settings dialog.

@common.mouse.sensitivity.slow.context: Mouse sensitivity choice (ZX Spectrum Next mouse): how fast the emulated pointer moves; keep the multiplier in brackets. Shown in the Machine menu and the Settings dialog.

@common.mouse.sensitivity.normal.context: Mouse sensitivity choice (ZX Spectrum Next mouse): how fast the emulated pointer moves; keep the multiplier in brackets. Shown in the Machine menu and the Settings dialog.

@common.mouse.sensitivity.fast.context: Mouse sensitivity choice (ZX Spectrum Next mouse): how fast the emulated pointer moves; keep the multiplier in brackets. Shown in the Machine menu and the Settings dialog.

@common.mouse.sensitivity.fastest.context: Mouse sensitivity choice (ZX Spectrum Next mouse): how fast the emulated pointer moves; keep the multiplier in brackets. Shown in the Machine menu and the Settings dialog.

@common.mouse.pointer.always.context: Choice of when the host's mouse pointer stays visible while the emulated machine has captured the mouse. Shown in the Machine menu and the Settings dialog.

common.mouse.pointer.unused: Only while no program reads the mouse

@common.mouse.pointer.unused.context: Choice of when the host's mouse pointer stays visible while the emulated machine has captured the mouse. Shown in the Machine menu and the Settings dialog.

@common.mouse.pointer.never.context: Choice of when the host's mouse pointer stays visible while the emulated machine has captured the mouse. Shown in the Machine menu and the Settings dialog.

@common.joystick.side.left.context: Name of the first joystick connector of the emulated machine. Shown in the Machine menu and the joystick bindings dialog.

@common.joystick.side.right.context: Name of the second joystick connector of the emulated machine. Shown in the Machine menu and the joystick bindings dialog.

@common.joystick.source.off.context: Choice of which host device plays an emulated joystick. Shown in the Machine menu and the joystick bindings dialog. Here: no device, the joystick is idle.

@common.joystick.source.keyboard.context: Choice of which host device plays an emulated joystick. Shown in the Machine menu and the joystick bindings dialog. 'Host' is the computer Klive runs on, as opposed to the emulated machine.

@common.joystick.source.gamepad.context: Choice of which host device plays an emulated joystick. Shown in the Machine menu and the joystick bindings dialog. 'Host' is the computer Klive runs on, as opposed to the emulated machine.

@common.button.yes.context: Button of a native confirmation/message dialog. Answers the dialog's question positively.

@common.button.no.context: Button of a native confirmation/message dialog. Answers the dialog's question negatively.

@common.button.ok.context: Button that closes a dialog, accepting it.

@common.button.cancel.context: Button that closes a dialog without doing anything.

@common.button.close.context: Button that closes a dialog or panel.

@common.filter.allFiles.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). Shows every file.

@common.filter.romFiles.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). ROM images of an emulated computer (.rom, .bin).

@common.filter.trdosDisks.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). TR-DOS floppy images (.trd/.scl).

@common.filter.tapeFiles.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). Tape images (.tap/.tzx).

@common.filter.diskFiles.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). Floppy disk images (.dsk).

@common.filter.szxSnapshot.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). 'zx-state' is the name of the .szx format; keep it.

@common.filter.z80Snapshot.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). 'Z80' is the name of the .z80 format.

@common.filter.snaSnapshot.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). 'SNA' is the name of the .sna format.

@common.filter.timexCartridges.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). Timex 2068 cartridge files (.dck).

@common.button.overwrite.context: Button of a native confirmation/message dialog. Replaces the existing file.

@common.filter.machineState.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). Klive's own machine state files (.kls).

@common.filter.machineStates.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). Klive's own machine state files (.kls), plural.

@common.button.load.context: Button of a native confirmation/message dialog. Loads the file despite the warning.

@common.filter.rzxRecordings.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). RZX files: recordings of a game's keyboard input. Keep 'RZX'.

@common.filter.rzxRecording.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). An RZX file: a recording of a game's keyboard input. Keep 'RZX'.

@common.filter.debugRecordings.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). Klive's own reverse-debugging session files (.klr).

@common.button.openEndState.context: Button of a native confirmation/message dialog. Opens only the final machine state of the recording.

@common.filter.keyMappingFiles.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). Key mapping files (.keymap).

@common.filter.emulatorFiles.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). Every file Klive's emulator can open.

@common.filter.spectrumSnapshots.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). ZX Spectrum snapshot files (.sna/.z80/.szx).

@common.filter.z88Snapshots.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). Cambridge Z88 snapshot files (.z88).

@common.filter.rzxRecordingsShort.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). RZX recordings (.rzx).

@common.filter.tapes.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). Tape images (.tap/.tzx).

@common.filter.zx80Programs.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). ZX80 program files (.o/.80).

@common.filter.zx81Programs.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). ZX81 program files (.p/.81).

@common.filter.textTrace.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). An instruction trace as plain text.

@common.filter.csvTrace.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open/Save file dialog (the drop-down of file types). An instruction trace as CSV (comma-separated values). Keep 'CSV'.

@common.filter.cimImages.context: File-type filter in an operating-system Open file dialog: compressed SD card images (.cim).

@common.button.closeDialog.context: Accessible name (screen readers, tooltip) of the X button in a dialog's title bar.

common.filter.label: Filter

@common.filter.label.context: Accessible name of the text box that filters a panel's list.

@common.filter.clear.context: Accessible name of the small X button that empties a panel's filter box.
